title: Chat
for: the team's chat tool: digests, alerts and red flags out; reading threads and requests in

manual.export: the digest is printed for a person to paste into the channel by hand
manual.drop: the channel itself; the repo keeps its copy in reports/ or memory/decision-log.md with the permalink

vendors.name: Slack
caveats: workspace admin must approve; only directory or internal apps
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__slack`) until checked
read and write are gated by the OAuth scopes granted; keep `oauth.scopes` minimal in the .mcp.json entry
this repo already posts through its own bot (scripts/slack_post.py); use the MCP for search and reading in a session, keep sending on the script

auth.where: browser grant on first use, as the person's Slack user

script.notes: the team's own Slack app (integrations/slack/); outbound posts only

vendors.name: Microsoft Teams
caveats: Work IQ Teams MCP is an Agent 365 preview; Microsoft documents Copilot Studio and VS Code as clients, not Claude; confirm it accepts an external MCP client before wiring
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__microsoft-teams`) until checked
the URL carries the tenant id (`TEAMS_TENANT_ID`, not a secret); the sign-in is Entra ID in the browser
seen only in a secondary listing; confirm the endpoint on Microsoft Learn on the day you wire it

auth.where: Entra ID sign-in in the browser; a tenant admin must allow external MCP clients
